7b

There is relative motion between the edges of the star and Earth, so due to the Doppler effect, the detected wavelength will be different from the emitted wavelength.

For the edge that is moving towards Earth the detected wavelength is shorter than the emitted wavelength (it is blue-shifted).

For the edge that is moving away from Earth the detected wavelength is longer than the emitted wavelength (it is red-shifted).
